instruction: Set up version control for this document using Writer's built-in Git integration to track all changes.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Writer does not have built-in Git integration or any native version control system. While Writer has a Track Changes feature for collaborative editing, it does not provide Git-based version control functionality that would allow tracking document history through Git commits.
